prompt:
A multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 3 columns and 3 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 8 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a clean photorealistic cinematic film still with natural skin texture and real adult faces, the same light and colour in every panel. Thin plain white gutters separate the panels. Location: JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, Night, warm interior downlights with cool elevator spill.
Image 1: the character sheet of 路少泽 (28), look S1
Image 2: the character sheet of 纪然 (27), look S3
Image 3: the location JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 4: the location JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 5: the location JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 6: the location JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people
Image 7: the location JI RAN'S APARTMENT ENTRANCE, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people
Image 8: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Image 9: the prop black handbag; use only structure, material, and color
Keep each character's face, hairstyle, body and outfit exactly as in their reference image. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the space, materials and light. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Axis runs along the side wall that holds the one framed autumn landscape painting. That wall stands between the one pair of brushed-steel elevator doors and the one walnut front door with its smart lock, which face each other. The camera stays in front of the painting wall, facing it, for the whole scene. Lu Shaoze, in his navy suit with his hair slicked back, stands at the walnut front door and faces it. The elevator doors behind him are closed. Ji Ran is unseen inside the elevator, in her ivory satin wrap blouse and black leather mini skirt, holding the black handbag. The wall sconce glows beside the painting.
Panel 1: Wide shot, locked-off camera, eye-level, facing the painting wall, with the walnut front door at frame right and the elevator doors at frame left. Lu Shaoze stands at the walnut front door, smooths his slicked-back hair with one hand and raps on the door with his knuckles.
Panel 2: Medium shot, handheld, eye-level, centered on the elevator doors behind Lu Shaoze's back. The elevator doors slide open and cool light spills out. Ji Ran steps out with the black handbag on her arm, her red heels striking the stone floor.
Panel 3: Medium shot, quick whip pan from the door to the elevator, low angle. Lu Shaoze startles, spins and bumps shoulder-first into Ji Ran. Both stagger and come to a stop beneath the autumn landscape painting, Lu Shaoze at its elevator end and Ji Ran at its front-door end.
Panel 4: Medium shot, over-the-shoulder shot past Ji Ran's shoulder onto Lu Shaoze, eye-level. Lu Shaoze straightens his jacket, then drawls with a smug, lopsided smile, looking her up and down.
Panel 5: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye-level. Ji Ran rolls her eyes and lifts her chin coolly, her grip settling on the black handbag strap.
Panel 6: Medium close-up, over-the-shoulder shot past Lu Shaoze's shoulder onto Ji Ran, eye-level. Ji Ran answers with a thin, cutting smile, her head tilted.
Panel 7: Close-up, slow push in on Lu Shaoze's face, eye-level. Lu Shaoze's smile stiffens and one eyebrow twitches.
Panel 8: Medium shot, low angle on Ji Ran beneath the painting. Ji Ran glances at the walnut front door behind her, then back at him with a cold smirk.
Keep the characters' identities and outfits, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no sketch or comic style.
